question: How can I reset my password?
answer: Go to the login page, click Forgot Password, and enter your registered email address. You will receive a password reset link by email. Follow the instructions to create a new password.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, and online bank transfers. All payments are processed through secure payment gateways.

question: How can I create an account?
answer: Click the Register button on the homepage. Enter your name, email address, and password, then submit the registration form. You may need to verify your email address.

question: How can I change my email address?
answer: Log in to your account, navigate to Account Settings, and select Change Email Address. Enter your new email address and verify it using the confirmation link.

question: I forgot my username. How can I recover it?
answer: Your username is usually the email address you used during registration. If you cannot remember it, contact customer support with your registered phone number.

question: How can I update my profile information?
answer: Log in to your account and open the Profile section. You can update your first name, last name, phone number, and address. Click Save Changes when finished.

question: Is it possible to delete my account?
answer: Yes, you can request account deletion by contacting customer support. Our team will verify your identity and guide you through the deletion process.

question: How can I change my password?
answer: Log in to your account, go to Security Settings, and select Change Password. Enter your current password and your new password twice, then save your changes.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery usually takes between 3 and 5 business days. Delivery times may vary depending on your location and product availability.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: Log in to your account and open the My Orders section. Select your order to view its current status and tracking information.

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: You can cancel your order before it has been shipped by contacting customer support. Once an order has been shipped, cancellation may no longer be possible.

question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
answer: You can request a delivery address change before your order is shipped. Contact customer support as soon as possible with your order number and updated address.

question: What should I do if my order has not arrived?
answer: First, check your order tracking information. If the estimated delivery date has passed, contact customer support with your order number so we can investigate.

question: Do you offer international shipping?
answer: International shipping availability depends on the destination country. Contact customer support to confirm whether delivery is available to your location.

question: How much does shipping cost?
answer: Shipping costs depend on the delivery address, package size, and selected delivery method. The shipping fee is displayed during checkout before you complete your payment.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: Customers can request a return within 14 days of receiving their order, provided the product meets the return conditions. Contact customer support to start a return request.

question: How can I request a refund?
answer: Contact customer support with your order number and reason for requesting a refund. After your return or refund request is approved, the payment will be processed through the original payment method.

question: How long does a refund take?
answer: Refunds are generally processed within 5 to 10 business days after approval. The time required for the funds to appear in your account depends on your bank or payment provider.

question: Can I exchange a damaged product?
answer: Yes, if you receive a damaged or defective product, contact customer support within 48 hours of delivery. Include your order number and photographs of the damaged item.

question: What should I do if I receive the wrong product?
answer: Contact customer support and provide your order number and a description of the incorrect item. Our team will help arrange a replacement or return.

question: Is online payment secure?
answer: Yes, payments are processed through secure payment gateways. We use security measures to protect payment transactions and do not store your full card details on our servers.

question: Why was my payment declined?
answer: A payment may be declined because of insufficient funds, incorrect card information, bank security restrictions, or an expired card. Contact your bank or try another payment method.

question: Can I get an invoice for my purchase?
answer: Yes, you can download your invoice from the My Orders section after your payment has been completed. If you cannot find it, contact customer support.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: You can contact our support team by emailing support@example.com. Please include your order number when asking about an existing purchase.

question: What are your customer support working hours?
answer: Our customer support team is available Monday through Friday, from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

question: How long does it take to receive a response from support?
answer: Our support team usually responds to customer inquiries within 24 business hours. Complex requests may require additional investigation.

question: Do you have a mobile application?
answer: You can access our services through our website using a mobile browser. Information about a dedicated mobile application is available from customer support.

question: Can I place an order without creating an account?
answer: Yes, guest checkout is available. You can provide your email address and delivery information during checkout without registering an account.

question: What happens if I enter an incorrect shipping address?
answer: If your order has not been shipped, contact customer support immediately to request an address correction. If the package is already in transit, changing the address may not be possible.

question: How can I protect my account from unauthorized access?
answer: Use a strong and unique password, never share your login credentials, and change your password if you suspect unauthorized access. Always log out when using a shared computer.
